business_scope.primary_industry_name: Virtual Expense Card Issuing and Spend Management Controls

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (national unitary jurisdiction; commercial registration administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP); financial activity licensing by the Central Bank of Oman (CBO))
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – civil-law-inspired codified commercial statutes with Sharia (Islamic law) as the constitutional source of legislation under the Basic Statute (Royal Decree No. 101/96, as amended) and a strong Islamic finance overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US–Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force January 2009; includes investment protections)
Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital in the Arab States (1980)
Oman–United Kingdom Double Taxation Arrangement and multiple DTAAs (40+ jurisdictions)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Law) and its implementing regulations; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law) imposing beneficial-owner identification and register obligations; Royal Decree No. 19/2019 (National Payment Systems Law) and CBO licensing/AML/CFT circulars for Payment Service Providers and E-Money Institutions; CBO AML/CFT Regulation issued under the Banking Law (Royal Decree No. 39/2014); UBO disclosure administered through the MoCIIP Commercial Registry (Invest Easy) with the Financial Information Unit (FIU) under the AML/CFT Law.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access – UBO data is filed with the Commercial Registry and held in the national corporate register; not publicly searchable; accessible to the CBO, FIU, tax authority, law enforcement and AML-obliged institutions on a lawful-request basis; nominee/shareholder anonymity is not recognized and all layers must be pierced to the natural person.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's domicile (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization – Oman is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be notarized, certified by the origin-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalized by the Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman in the origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Omani Single Person Company (SPC), approving the memorandum, and appointing the first manager/subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's domicile

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / register of directors and shareholders of the foreign corporate shareholder (for UBO piercing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or registered agent of the foreign corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies and bank references of Ultimate Beneficial Owners and the appointed SPC manager/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the origin country (notarized copies) and issuing bank (reference letter)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization for notarized identity copies; original bank references may be presented directly to the Omani formation counsel

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney from the foreign shareholder to the Omani filing agent / formation counsel (executed and signature-verified)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the origin country or the Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, managers and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions, and the domestic list maintained by the Omani National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism; enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for foreign and domestic PEPs, family members and close associates per Royal Decree No. 30/2016 and CBO AML/CFT regulations; adverse-media checks and continuous transaction monitoring are required; screening results and rationale must be documented in the UBO file and retained for no less than five years post-termination of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy – Oman's unified business registration portal (https://investeasy.gov.om) operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP); integrated with the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) attestation workflow.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Commercial names must be submitted in Arabic; an English transliteration may accompany the Arabic legal name but the Arabic form prevails for legal and registration purposes. The name must be distinctive, non-misleading, and not identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name. The name must include the legal-form suffix corresponding to the Single Person Company structure (e.g., 'SPC' / 'Single Person Company — L.L.C.'). Regulated activity terms require a sector regulator no-objection; the approved name must align with the ISIC-coded commercial activity (6619 / virtual card issuing).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, MoCIIP states the ground in the Invest Easy case file. The applicant may (1) re-file with up to two alternative names immediately at the standard tariff; (2) file a written grievance with the Director General of Commercial Registration within 15 working days of rejection, attaching the rejection notice, the legalized corporate documents, and, where relevant, a CBO no-objection letter for regulated financial terms; (3) apply to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion for ministerial reconsideration within 30 days of the grievance refusal; and (4) seek judicial review before the Administrative Court (Muscat) within 60 days of the final administrative decision. A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 60-day period by payment of the renewal tariff before expiry; cumulative validity beyond 120 days is not permitted and a fresh application is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered address. A physical, dedicated office lease within the Sultanate is mandatory before the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate is issued, and the CBO-licensed virtual-card activity requires a substantive operational office in Muscat with a country manager, MLRO, compliance personnel and systems hosted or mirrored in Oman. Licensed serviced offices are tolerated only during the interim pre-CBO-license structuring phase and must be upgraded to dedicated premises before card issuance commences.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 85% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of CBO licensure; 70% per annum thereafter for recurring AML/CFT inspections; CBO conducts mandatory prudential and thematic on-site examinations of licensed payment and e-money institutions; MoCIIP or Muscat Municipality spot checks on the registered address at formation are low (10–15%) but materially increase upon any PEP relationship, sanctions alert, or UBO documentation irregularity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial name clearance and reservation (statutory fee for up to 3 name variants, including English transliteration check)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Commercial Registration Executive Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization bundle for 4 foreign corporate documents (certificate of incorporation, board resolution, incumbency certificate, UBO identity copies; covering notary, origin-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation, and Oman Embassy legalization)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public (origin), origin-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular and notarial tariffs (approx. USD 350 per document bundle)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation of the legalized document set (including attestation of the Arabic translation in Oman)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Oman-licensed legal translation office / Omani notary

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register statutory filing and beneficial-ownership disclosure fee
Notarization of power of attorney to formation counsel and notarization of subscriber signatures for the SPC memorandum
PEP, sanctions and adverse-media screening subscription (annual seat covering UN, OFAC, EU, UK HMT and Omani National Committee lists; includes UBOs, directors and authorized signatories)
Provisional registered-address arrangement with a licensed serviced-office provider in Muscat (3-month term pending full office lease)
Pre-incorporation legal due diligence, UBO piercing report, AML/CFT policy gap assessment, and CBO licensing roadmap memorandum
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Omani counsel / international law firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Formation agent / Invest Easy e-filing, Commercial Registration liaison, and document-handling fee
Preliminary Muscat Municipality activity approval letter for the virtual-card-issuer commercial activity (zoning and activity clearance)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Omani Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019, as amended), Chapter on Single Person Companies; Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019); Electronic Payment Systems regulations of the Central Bank of Oman
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Commercial Registration Directorate, Invest Easy e-Services Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (Arabic), Commercial Registration Application Form, and SPC shareholder declaration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SPC under Royal Decree No. 18/2019; capital is determined by the sole shareholder and must be fully subscribed and paid in cash or in kind. For the Central Bank of Oman Business Payment Services license, the applicant must meet CBO regulatory minimum capital requirements for payment institutions (typically OMR 500,000 or equivalent) and maintain client-fund safeguarding/escrow arrangements.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: the draft Memorandum and Articles of Association are approved and adopted, and the Sole Shareholder's subscription to the paid-up share capital is ratified. RESOLVED: the registered office is fixed at [Registered Address], Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman. RESOLVED: [Name] is appointed General Manager, [Name] Company Secretary/Compliance Officer, and [Name] AML Reporting Officer, each to act within statutory authority. RESOLVED: the said officers are authorised to open corporate bank accounts, execute filings with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and submit the Central Bank of Oman Business Payment Services license application. RESOLVED: any officer, shareholder, or counsel is authorised to execute and deliver all necessary instruments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and CBO Non-Objection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Invest Easy Portal; Central Bank of Oman (CBO) Banking Licensing and Payment Systems Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed Arabic and English corporate names via the Invest Easy portal. After preliminary name screening, file a written business-concept application to the CBO requesting a non-objection letter for the scope 'B2B virtual card issuance and spend management services'. The CBO must confirm that the corporate name and activity description do not infringe the licensed-banking exclusivity.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Business plan of the virtual card issuing entity
CBO non-objection application with activity description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed names are rejected, re-submit with alternative denominations using distinct Arabic transliterations. If the CBO raises scope objections, narrow the activity wording to 'corporate payment facilitation technology services' and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directorate of Notaries, Ministry of Justice; Licensed Commercial Law Firm
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct an Omani-licensed law firm to draft the bilingual Arabic/English Memorandum and Articles of Association (MoA/AoA). The sole shareholder must execute the document before a certified notary public in Oman (or at an Omani consulate abroad). Ensure that the corporate object clause expressly covers 'issuance and administration of payment cards and e-money instruments for corporate clients under CBO license'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a query, correct formal defects such as mismatched national identification numbers or capital figures, re-issue certified copies, and re-execute before the notary for fresh attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application Filing and Official Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation application through the Invest Easy portal attaching the notarized MoA/AoA, CBO non-objection, and proof of registered office address. Pay the statutory commercial registration and publication fees online. The system will issue a payment receipt and initiate the legal existence of the SPC upon approval.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney for the authorized incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, remedy within 10 business days by uploading corrected corporate documents or clarifying the capital structure; pay any re-filing surcharge and resubmit for re-assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation approval, the MoCIIP issues the Commercial Register (CR) certificate bearing a unique CR number and the SPC's legal name. Verify accuracy of all corporate particulars, including governance structure and licensed objectives, before proceeding to ancillary registrations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CR certificate contains data discrepancies, file a formal correction amendment with supporting evidence; statutory amendments are processed within a further five business days without dissolution risk.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipality Business License and OCCI Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality Business Licensing Directorate; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a municipal business permit (Sijil Maroof) for the corporate office and obtain a lease-related occupancy indication. Concurrently request OCCI membership registration to secure the Chamber of Commerce certificate enabling Customs, banking, and visa services.
required_dossiers: Lease contract for the commercial office
Civil Defense preliminary fire safety approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality rejects the premises, provide an updated lease or relocate the registered office to a permitted commercial grade-A building; re-file the municipal application through the Tijara portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA); Public Authority for Social Insurance (PASI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SPC for Corporate Income Tax with the OTA and obtain the 10-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN), and register for VAT if taxable supplies exceed the mandatory threshold or as a voluntary registrant. If the company hires local or expatriate employees, complete PASI registration and set up contribution schedules.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA or PASI raises clarification, respond with translated corporate documents and remuneration policy; late registration penalty can be waived upon demonstrating ongoing application within statutory timelines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Office Compliance and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Royal Oman Police Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority; Muscat Municipality Building Control
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct fire safety inspection of the registered office, install approved fire extinguishers and emergency signage, and obtain the Fire Safety Clearance Certificate. Secure final occupancy clearance and post-license inspection approval from Muscat Municipality. Retain onsite copies of the CR, municipal license, fire certificate, and CBO application receipt for display.
required_dossiers: Fire extinguisher and alarm maintenance contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Civil Defense Authority issues violation notices, remedy by rectifying fire safety equipment and re-inspecting; a temporary operational permit may be requested pending final clearance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Central Bank of Oman, Payment Systems Supervision Department; Financial Services Authority (as supervisory coordinant)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Payment Services Provider License for Virtual Card Issuance and Corporate Spend Management (under CBO Electronic Payment Framework and BIN Sponsorship rules)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman (EA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III - Environmental Registration (low-impact IT service operations; no manufacturing, no bulk industrial discharge)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions; zero discharge of regulated industrial pollutants; IT e-waste and residual electronic materials must be handed over to licensed recyclers with documented disposal manifests per EA waste management regulations; backup generator emissions (if any) must comply with local air quality limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the Royal Oman Police Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority; structural and occupancy clearance from Muscat Municipality confirming load and evacuation compliance; Ministry of Labour workplace health and safety certificate for the office floor and employee occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Directorate General of Tax, Muscat; e-service portal at https://www.taxoman.gov.om (OTA Digital Tax Services platform)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Omani Single Person Company (SPC) must register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Oman Tax Authority before commencing activity. The foreign shareholder files the OTA registration form via the Oman Tax Authority e-portal, submitting (i) the certified constitutional deed and articles of the SPC, (ii) certificate of commercial registration from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, (iii) the prior special / high-risk license approval issued by the Central Bank of Oman for virtual card issuance and payment services, (iv) proof of local registered office, and (v) passport/CRP of the shareholder and manager. OTA issues a unique TIN and issues a VAT registration number simultaneously if the SPC's taxable supplies exceed the statutory thresholds. For non-resident entities without a permanent establishment, OTA requires a tax representative appointment before issuing the TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Omani SPC is taxed as a separate juridical person under the Omani Income Tax Law, with no pass-through of losses or income to the foreign shareholder; the SPC is also a distinct taxable person under the Omani VAT Law.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or US-style entity classification election exists under Omani tax law. An SPC may elect voluntary VAT registration under Article 44 of the VAT Executive Regulations where annual taxable supplies exceed OMR 250,000 but remain below the mandatory OMR 500,000 threshold. The SPC may also elect the Small or Medium Enterprise income tax regime if it meets the Omani SME turnover and ownership criteria, subject to prior approval by OTA. Hybrid mismatch election mechanisms are limited to alignment rules under the OECD BEPS Action 2 framework as adopted through Oman's CbCR / international tax compliance; no separate domestic hybrid election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Unified GCC VAT Framework and the Omani VAT Law (Royal Decree 121/2020 as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 500,000 of annual taxable supplies / reverse-charge / import value in the preceding 12 months. Voluntary registration: OMR 250,000 of annual taxable supplies. A non-resident SPC is subject to mandatory registration where it becomes liable to pay VAT in Oman through a permanent establishment or through specified reverse-charge transactions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman does not currently operate a real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate. Taxpayers are required to issue tax invoices under VAT Law Article 49; approved e-invoicing software is acceptable, and OTA has published guidelines for archiving XML/PDF invoices. A phased mandatory e-invoicing regime with integrated digital reporting is under development but, as of the current regime, there is no API-based clearance of every invoice with OTA in real time.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available for (i) the physical export of goods outside Oman and outside the GCC customs union, provided export occurs within 90 days of the supply and the supplier retains mandated export evidence; (ii) international transport of goods or passengers where the destination is outside Oman and the transport is provided to a non-resident; (iii) supplies of services to a non-resident customer outside Oman, including overseas card-management and B2B fintech service contracts, subject to the place-of-supply rules and proof that such services are not supplied from a permanent establishment in Oman; and (iv) certain diplomatic/relief supplies. For the virtual-card issuing business, clearing, interchange and B2B spend-platform fees charged to a non-resident principal are zero-rated if the recipient is outside Oman and direct use or benefit of the service occurs outside Oman.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Oman Customs draft declaration / discharge proof)
Bill of Lading (or equivalent airway bill, SRO, sea waybill / export cargo manifest)
Inward Remittance Certificate (FX inward receipt / bank credit confirmation evidencing payment from the foreign customer)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: OTA may disregard an export zero-rating claim if the required documentation is missing, incomplete or inconsistent, and will reverse the zero-rating with VAT assessed at 5% plus delayed payment interest at 1.5% per month or part month. Fraudulent zero-rating claims or repeated documentation failures are subject to penalties up to 100% of the tax due, administrative fines, imprisonment for tax evasion under the Omani Income Tax and VAT Law enforcement provisions, and indefinite suspension of the SPC's electronic invoicing / refund entitlements; serious cases trigger criminal investigation and the denial of future zero-rating claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) - 中央? no, English only.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion - Directorate General of Commercial Registration via Invest Easy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the CR certificate expiry date (registration anniversary); Invest Easy renewal window opens 90 calendar days prior; 30-day grace period at increased fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of OMR 5 plus OMR 1 per day beyond the grace period; commercial registration suspended after 90 days of default; continued non-renewal leads to administrative strike-off and cancellation of the SPC name

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation and Members' Register Certification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion - UBO Register administered through Invest Easy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with each CR renewal; any direct or indirect ownership change must additionally be notified within 30 days of the triggering transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of up to OMR 5,000 (approx. USD 13,000) for failure to maintain or file accurate UBO data; false declarations are referred to the national Financial Intelligence Unit under Oman AML Law (Royal Decree 30/2016)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Central Bank of Oman Annual Regulatory and Statistical Return for Licensed Payment Card Issuer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Central Bank of Oman - Banking Supervision Department and Payment Systems Oversight
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end (31 March for a calendar-year SPC) in accordance with CBO reporting circulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: CBO supervisory fines for late or deficient filings; downgrade of AML/CFT risk rating; suspension or revocation of the card-issuing authorization for persistent non-compliance, with consequential notification to MCIIP for CR strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return with Audited Financial Statements and Tax Computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Secretariat General of Taxation - Ministry of Finance (Oman Tax Authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the tax year-end (30 April for a calendar-year SPC); discretionary extension of up to 3 months available upon written request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative late-filing penalty; late payment attracts a 10% penalty on the unpaid tax plus annual interest of 10% on arrears; prolonged default allows official estimated assessment, tax certificate suspension and enforcement attachment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return Filing with Audited Financial Statements (non-tax statutory filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion - Commercial Registrar via Invest Easy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end (30 June for a calendar-year SPC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fine of up to OMR 5,000 (approx. USD 13,000); CR renewal, official document stamping and Invest Easy services are blocked until audited financial statements are filed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Muscat Municipality (or the governorate municipality where the registered office is located)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 December for the following calendar year; grace period until 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily late penalty of OMR 1 applied after the grace period, capped at OMR 100; continued non-renewal triggers municipal closure and seizure orders against unlicensed office premises

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All entities formed under the Oman Commercial Companies Law, including foreign-owned Single Person Companies, must appoint an auditor licensed by MCIIP and file full audited financial statements annually; no minimum revenue or asset threshold exemption exists. CBO-licensed virtual card issuers are additionally subject to prudential audit and an independent AML/CFT compliance review
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for use in Oman; private SPCs commonly apply IFRS for SMEs; statutory books must be maintained in Omani Riyals and Arabic, with an English translation accepted for filing

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO data is captured in Invest Easy and must be re-confirmed at every CR renewal; any direct or indirect ownership change, including the disposal of the single share in the SPC, must be lodged with the Commercial Registrar and recorded in the statutory register of members before the annual confirmation is accepted; the registrar cross-checks the UBO declaration against the shareholders list and the audited financial statements
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders) with UBO ownership trail
Register of Directors and Managers of the SPC
Register of Charges (security interests and pledges)
General Assembly and Manager Meeting Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 1,500 per year for registered office facilities, resident agent, power-of-attorney services and company secretarial support in Muscat
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 12,000 per year depending on card transaction volumes, number of card scheme rails, and the depth of CBO-required audit procedures

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% (Royal Decree 9/2023, effective 1 January 2023; replaces the prior 12%/15% tiered structure)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No nationwide CIT holiday for fintech/card issuers. Preferential 12% rate applies only to small taxpayers with taxable income not exceeding OMR 100,000 per tax year. Qualifying free-zone entities (e.g., Duqm SEZAD, Salalah Free Zone, Sohar Free Zone) may access zone-specific CIT holidays or reduced rates, subject to holding a valid free-zone license and meeting local substance requirements. No R&D super-deduction or notional interest deduction is currently available.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Corporate Income Tax Return (Form ICT-01, 'Income Tax Return for Companies') filed electronically through the Oman Tax Authority (OTA) e-Filing Portal at https://taxoman.gov.om. The SPC must be registered for an Omani TIN before filing; non-resident owners cannot file the SPC return under their foreign TIN.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months from the end of the tax year. For a calendar-year SPC, the return and full tax payment are due by 30 April of the following year. OTA may grant a discretionary extension of up to 2 additional months upon written request and advance payment of estimated tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and Commercial Registration (CR) number of the Omani SPC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Omani TIN and CR issued to the SPC. Do not enter the foreign parent's TIN.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax year and fiscal period (from - to dates)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the SPC's elected financial year, typically 1 January - 31 December; any change of accounting period requires prior OTA approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal form, principal activity code, and license details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'Single Person Company (SPC)' and ISIC 6619. Attach a copy of the CBO/CMA payment-institution or card-issuance license; non-resident 100% ownership is permissible but must be declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: issuance fees, program management fees, interchange income, merchant fees, FX/spread, and cardholder charges
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue derived through the Omani SPC's license, including global card transactions routed through the Oman entity. Pure offshore revenue attributable to a foreign permanent establishment may be excluded only with supporting TP and substance documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales and direct operating expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only expenses incurred for the SPC's own account. Recharges from the non-resident parent for network access, scheme fees, or software must be supported by full intercompany agreements and TP documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General, administrative, staff, technology, and compliance expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC must demonstrate real local substance: salaries, office rent, AML compliance costs, auditors' fees. Head-office allocations are not automatically deductible.
Derived from audited IFRS financial statements of the Omani SPC; the audit report must be uploaded.
Add back excessive interest, unsupported cash payments, fines, profits distributed as disguised fees, and any cross-border amounts on which WHT was not withheld at 10%.
Losses are tradable only if ownership continuity and the same business activity are maintained. Non-resident SPCs may not claim foreign losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss offset and applicable rate (15%; 12% if taxable income ≤ OMR 100,000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the correct rate. A foreign-owned SPC still qualifies for the small-taxpayer rate if it meets the statutory income threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed CIT, advance payments, WHT credits, and foreign tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach Omani withholding tax certificates and, for treaty claims, the approved DTA relief letter and TRC of the ultimate beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction declaration and transfer pricing disclosure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all transactions with the non-resident parent, including software licensing, program management, scheme access, and loans; state the arm's-length methodology (e.g., TNMM, CUP) and attach comparables if requested.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a surcharge of 5% of the tax due for each month or part of a month of delay, capped at 25% of the tax due, plus a fixed administrative fine of OMR 100-1,000 per return. Late payment: additional monthly surcharge on unpaid tax (up to 25%). Failure to file at all after reminder may trigger a deemed-profit assessment (10-18% of gross revenue), loss of audit rights, and travel-ban enforcement. Incorrect or dishonest returns attract fraud penalties up to 100% of the tax under-assessed and criminal referral.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% domestic rate: dividends distributed by an Omani SPC to a non-resident shareholder are not subject to Omani withholding tax under domestic law. The SPC is therefore not legally required to withhold on dividends, but must report distributions if requested.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke reduced or zero rate under an Oman DTA: (1) obtain an Omani TIN for the non-resident payee; (2) submit an OTA DTA relief application before the payment date; (3) provide a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the payee's jurisdiction, apostilled/legalized, covering the payment year; (4) provide a Beneficial Ownership declaration confirming no pass-through arrangement; and (5) obtain OTA written approval. If relief is not obtained before payment, the payer must withhold at 10% and the payee may file a refund/relief application with OTA within the statutory period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and IP licence fees: 10% statutory, often 0% or reduced under DTAs (e.g., 0% under several GCC treaties, 10% cap under OECD-based treaties). Interest: no general statutory WHT on ordinary bank interest; profit-based or excess returns may attract 10%. Management fees, technical service fees, and services rendered in Oman: 10% statutory, reduced only where the non-resident has no Omani PE and the applicable DTA contains a services or business-profits article.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No published Oman-specific Local File/Master File monetary threshold for an SPC; however, all related-party transactions must be disclosed annually and substantiated contemporaneously. OTA may request a full TP documentation package where aggregate related-party revenue or expenditure exceeds OMR 500,000 in a tax year. Country-by-Country Reporting applies to Omani-parented MNE groups with consolidated group revenue of at least OMR 375,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations statute similar to the UAE, but the Income Tax Law (RD 9/2023) contains substance-over-form, GAAR, and beneficial-ownership rules. For a licensed B2B virtual-card issuer, OTA, the Central Bank of Oman, and CMA require: a physical registered office in Oman, local directors and compliance officers, actual management of card programs, local AML/KYC decisions, and substantive employment. A shell entity or a mere booking vehicle used to divert profits offshore will be disregarded, with profits re-attributed to the controlling foreign entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting interchange income, scheme fees, issuance fees, or merchant settlement income; inflating intercompany expenses; using unreported e-wallets or foreign acquiring accounts to conceal card program revenue; submitting false audited statements to OTA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines equal to 100%-200% of the under-assessed tax (up to 3x under prior law), additional fixed penalties up to OMR 50,000, deemed-profit assessment, seizure of records, and revocation of tax clearance; criminal referral to the Public Prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the sole shareholder who sign false returns become jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud. Penalties include civil restitution, travel ban, asset freeze, and imprisonment for up to 3 years; the Commercial Registration may be struck off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a paper SPC with no office, employees, or local board; taking card issuance decisions offshore while booking profits in Oman only to access zero dividend WHT or treaty benefits; conducting related-party transactions without economic rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OTA disregards the SPC under GAAR/substance-over-form; recharacterizes the structure; denies treaty benefits; imposes a deemed-profit tax assessment of up to 18% of gross revenue; additional fines up to OMR 10,000 and denial of loss carryforward.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owner loses limited liability protection; OTA may issue a travel ban and worldwide asset freeze against the controlling shareholder; director personally liable for restitution where SPC funds were diverted to private use.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing branded virtual cards, e-money, or payment accounts without a Central Bank of Oman license or CMA capital markets license; using foreign issuer-processor arrangements to bypass Omani licensing; failing to apply AML/KYC, transaction monitoring, or suspicious transaction reporting; facilitating money laundering through corporate virtual card programs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CBO/CMA enforcement: cease-and-desist order, fines of OMR 10,000-500,000, daily penalty for continuing breach, and forced winding-up; AML Law (Royal Decree 30/2016): fines up to OMR 100,000, confiscation of proceeds, and disqualification from the financial sector.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the SPC's sole shareholder face personal criminal liability for money laundering if they knew or should have known of the scheme; imprisonment up to 7 years, travel bans, extradition exposure, and permanent prohibition from serving as director of any licensed entity in Oman.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax and Cross-Border Payment Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying royalties, management fees, technical service fees, or deemed distributions to a non-resident parent without withholding 10% and without an OTA-approved DTA relief; disguising profit repatriation as 'interest-free loans' or 'cost-splitting' without substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: OTA assesses the unpaid 10% WHT as a primary liability plus a penalty up to OMR 10,000; deductibility of the underlying payment is denied in the SPC's CIT return; late remittance surcharges accrue; non-filed WHT has no limitation period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or execute un-withheld payments are jointly liable for the 10% WHT, penalties, and interest; enforcement includes bank garnishment and travel ban; criminal referral for deliberate evasion can result in imprisonment up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying the foreign parent excessive fees for software licenses, card network access, risk management, or 'white-label' program services that are not at arm's length; failing to prepare or produce TP documentation; using a fixed 5% markup without comparables; maintaining thin capitalization with shareholder debt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment to arm's-length results with additional tax at 15%; penalties from 10% to 50% of the adjusted tax; fixed fines of OMR 1,000-5,000 for non-disclosure; interest on underpayment; potential de facto denial of the entire payment if substance is absent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If a TP adjustment arises from deliberate misrepresentation or manipulated financial statements, the filing director and beneficial owner are personally liable for the additional tax; OTA may impose a travel ban and refer for fraud prosecution; the SPC's limited liability may be pierced for misconduct.
